root.label: Root path
root.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to index. Must be within a configured local_roots allowlist.

follow_symlinks.label: Follow symlinks
follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links while scanning the library.

recursive.label: Recursive scan
recursive.description: Index audio files in subdirectories recursively.

extensions.label: File extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated list of audio file extensions to index (e.g. .mp3, .flac).

exclude.label: Exclude patterns
exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for paths to skip during scanning.

allow_write_tags.label: Allow metadata write-back
allow_write_tags.description: Allow Songhive to write metadata tags back to the source files. Requires write permission on the root directory.

allow_rename_source.label: Allow source renaming
allow_rename_source.description: Allow Songhive to rename source files through track edits. Requires write permission on the root directory.

allow_delete_source.label: Allow source deletion
allow_delete_source.description: Allow deleting source files from the filesystem. Requires write permission on the root directory.

allow_hashing.label: Allow audio hashing
allow_hashing.description: Compute a stable audio hash for tracks to detect duplicates and support transcoding.

fast_hash.label: Use fast raw hash
fast_hash.description: Use raw SHA-256 instead of ffmpeg audio-only hashing. Faster but changes when tags or artwork change.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.description: Name of the S3 bucket containing the audio files.

prefix.label: Key prefix
prefix.description: Only index objects under this prefix (e.g. music/). Leave empty to scan the whole bucket.

endpoint_url.label: Endpoint URL
endpoint_url.description: Custom endpoint for S3-compatible services (e.g. MinIO). Leave empty for AWS.

region.label: Region
region.description: AWS region of the bucket. Optional for most S3-compatible services.

access_key.label: Access key
access_key.description: Access key ID. Leave empty to use the server's ambient credentials.

secret_key.label: Secret key
secret_key.description: Secret access key paired with the access key. Stored encrypted.

path_style.label: Path-style addressing
path_style.description: Use path-style URLs (bucket/key) instead of virtual-hosted style. Required by some S3-compatible services such as MinIO.

presigned_urls.label: Stream via presigned URLs
presigned_urls.description: Redirect clients to short-lived presigned URLs for playback instead of proxying audio through Songhive.

presigned_expiry_seconds.label: Presigned URL expiry (seconds)
presigned_expiry_seconds.description: How long generated streaming URLs stay valid (60–604800).

extensions.label: File extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated list of audio file extensions to index (e.g. .mp3, .flac).

exclude.label: Exclude patterns
exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for object keys to skip during scanning.

recursive.label: Recursive scan
recursive.description: Index objects in nested key prefixes. Disable to index only keys directly under the prefix.

allow_hashing.label: Allow audio hashing
allow_hashing.description: Compute a stable audio hash for tracks to detect duplicates and support transcoding. Requires downloading new or changed objects once.

fast_hash.label: Use fast raw hash
fast_hash.description: Use raw SHA-256 instead of ffmpeg audio-only hashing. Cheaper but changes when tags or artwork change.

allow_write_tags.label: Allow metadata write-back
allow_write_tags.description: Allow Songhive to rewrite embedded tags and re-upload objects when tracks are edited.

allow_rename_source.label: Allow source renaming
allow_rename_source.description: Allow Songhive to rename objects through track edits. Requires write permission on the bucket.

allow_delete_source.label: Allow source deletion
allow_delete_source.description: Allow deleting objects from the bucket. Requires write permission on the bucket.

host.label: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SFTP/SSH server. The remote host must be reachable from the Songhive server — all file access happens server-side.

port.label: Port
port.description: SSH port of the remote server (usually 22).

username.label: Username
username.description: SSH username used to log in to the remote server.

password.label: Password
password.description: SSH password. May be combined with a private key; the server picks whichever method it accepts. Stored encrypted.

private_key.label: Private key
private_key.description: PEM or OpenSSH private key for public-key authentication. Paste the full key including the BEGIN/END lines. Stored encrypted.

private_key_passphrase.label: Private key passphrase
private_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase protecting the private key, if it is encrypted. Stored encrypted.

verify_host_key.label: Verify host key
verify_host_key.description: Verify the server's SSH host key. When enabled, the host must be listed in the known hosts data below or in the server's ~/.ssh/known_hosts file.

known_hosts.label: Known hosts
known_hosts.description: OpenSSH known_hosts lines used to verify the server's host key, e.g. "host.example ssh-ed25519 AAAA...". Only used when host key verification is enabled.

root.label: Remote root
root.description: Directory on the remote server to index. Relative paths resolve against the SSH user's home directory; leave empty to index the home directory itself.

connect_timeout.label: Connect timeout (seconds)
connect_timeout.description: How long to wait for the SSH connection and login to complete.

follow_symlinks.label: Follow symlinks
follow_symlinks.description: Whether to follow symbolic links while scanning the remote library.

recursive.label: Recursive scan
recursive.description: Index audio files in remote subdirectories recursively.

extensions.label: File extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated list of audio file extensions to index (e.g. .mp3, .flac).

exclude.label: Exclude patterns
exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns for remote paths to skip during scanning.

allow_hashing.label: Allow audio hashing
allow_hashing.description: Compute a stable audio hash for tracks to detect duplicates and support transcoding. Requires downloading new or changed files once.

fast_hash.label: Use fast raw hash
fast_hash.description: Use raw SHA-256 instead of ffmpeg audio-only hashing. Cheaper but changes when tags or artwork change.

allow_write_tags.label: Allow metadata write-back
allow_write_tags.description: Allow Songhive to rewrite embedded tags and re-upload files when tracks are edited. Requires write permission on the remote server.

allow_rename_source.label: Allow source renaming
allow_rename_source.description: Allow Songhive to rename remote files through track edits. Requires write permission on the remote server.

allow_delete_source.label: Allow source deletion
allow_delete_source.description: Allow deleting files on the remote server. Requires write permission on the remote server.
